title: org query columns JSON output
description: Schema for the JSON output of 'org query columns --format json'.

columns.description: Compiled column header specifications in display order.

rows.description: Evaluated heading rows in outline order.

width.description: Optional explicit display width in characters from %[WIDTH].

summary.description: Optional bottom-up summary rollup operator ('+', ':', 'X', or null).

locator.description: Canonical OrgLocator string for the entry.

file.description: Path to the Org source file containing the entry.

line.description: One-based line number of the heading.

title.description: Heading title text when projected separately.

todo.description: Optional TODO state keyword on the heading.

priority.description: Optional priority cookie character on the heading.

tags.description: Optional tag list attached to the heading.

properties.description: Optional raw drawer properties on the heading.

values.description: Evaluated column cell values keyed by canonical uppercase property name.
